'''Tadhg P. Begley''' is an Irish chemist and Distinguished Professor, [[Robert A. Welch Foundation]] Chair and [[Derek Barton]] Chair of Chemistry at [[Texas A&M University]],<ref name="TAMU">{{Cite web |url=http://www.chem.tamu.edu/faculty/tadhg-begley/ |title=Tadhg Begley |publisher=tamu.edu |accessdate=5 August 2016}}</ref> and also a published author of books.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.worldcat.org/identities/lccn-n2004123001/ |title=Begley, Tadhg P. |publisher=worldcat.org |accessdate=5 August 2016}}</ref> His honors include Elected Fellow of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]], [[National Institutes of Health]] Merit Award, [[National University of Chemistry]] Honorary D.Sc.<ref name="TAMU"/>
